description: Hi my name is Seraphim, a computer science major with an interest in game development. My goal at this event is to help with project management, presentation, and working with the team to design a website that will support the showcase of the project. Team members that would be helpful would be someone with experience in both software and accessible design.
summary:
Mission Ares is a 2D pixel art RPG video game built to teach kids about the tasks astronauts perform in space. Many kids grow up thinking that space is cool, but may not be aware of what people do once they are launched up into space. Many educational games are either too simple to explain what scientists and engineers do, or too complicated for children to understand. The games that children do find fun are science fiction and do not accurately show what astronauts do.

Project Ares uses game mechanics and visuals that children love while referencing real facts and challenges. Resource management and planning out missions are important to the safety of astronauts when in space and have to make the most of your time.

We aim to not only encourage children to persue STEM, but also recognize that a career in space does not have one path, but rather, see that a diverse team of crewmembers is important to a successful mission.
details:
This project was programmed through godot in GDScript. We used GitHub for version control.

The project is intended to present scientific information to children in a digestable way. We incorporated real world actions to children in a manner that is entertaining. Many educational environments create games that feel more like tools. We wanted to create a game that educated people, but still felt like a game.

The gameplay involves controlling a mars rover to reach a destination site, and obtain geological data.
